facts.fact: Connecting Africa reports that Ethio Telecom, Djibouti Telecom and Sudatel turned their December 2024 Horizon Fiber memorandum into a binding agreement for a terrestrial corridor from Djibouti's landing stations through Ethiopia to Sudan's; the document gives no signing day, so its published date is used.

systems.owner: Ethio Telecom, Djibouti Telecom, Sudatel Group
